summary: Fase 1 SALES regression (prasyarat Midtrans) tested end-to-end. Backend: /app/scripts/test_fase1_sales.py 14/14 PASS covering SALES-13 (email tamu wajib, akun auto-fill), COD removed (order 400 & /api/payment-methods no cod), SALES-10 idempotency (6 requests → 1 order, stock delta=1, cross-user key rejected 400), SALES-06 payment_deadline≈24h + cron auth (401 wrong secret, 202 correct, duplicate ack on same X-Webhook-Id, expired-only cancels & stock restored, pending-with-proof preserved), SALES-07 voucher release on cancel (used_count restored, redemption row deleted, re-use ok for per_user_limit=1), SALES-09 free shipping threshold (shipping.price=0 & total=subtotal-discount). Prior BUG-SALES-01..05 pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sales_flow.py 10 passed / 1 skipped. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) /checkout only has checkout-payment-tab-transfer + checkout-payment-tab-ewallet (no -cod); (b) AddressDialog now blocks save without email (dialog stays open on empty email; card shows tamu@example.com after save via checkout-address-email); (c) /pesanan-sukses hero data-state transitions correctly for CP00000143=waiting ('Menunggu pembayaran.' + order-payment-deadline + order-payment-countdown), CP00000144=paid ('Terima kasih!'), CP00000145=cancelled+expired ('Pesanan dibatalkan.' with 'Dibatalkan · Kedaluwarsa' status chip and Total Tagihan label); (d) /akun account-tab-orders shows order-payment-deadline-compact 'Bayar sebelum 27 Sep 2026, 19.00' on unpaid pending row + 'Batalkan' button only on that row; (e) admin /admin/pengaturan no longer contains 'Biaya COD' text, still has 'Ambang Gratis Ongkir'; (f) admin /admin/media loads (folders, upload, dari URL, folder baru, bulk grid, hotlink warning); (g) regression: admin order detail for unpaid pending transfer CP00000143 has NO admin-order-status-select rendered (nextOptions=[]), so 'Dibayar' cannot be picked.

issues: Grup select still exposes a 'COD' option (line 246 of AdminSettingsPage.js) even though COD is removed. If admin picks it, /api/payment-methods will store a cod method that the checkout will never render (frontend groups are transfer/ewallet only) and any order created against it would be rejected 400 by the backend. Cosmetic/dead option — recommend removing SelectItem value='cod' to prevent operator confusion.

action_items: (Minor cosmetic) Remove SelectItem value='cod' from the Grup dropdown in AdminSettingsPage.js (line 246) so admins cannot create a dead COD payment method.
critical_code_review_comments: services/orders.create_order: email precedence (payload.email → user.email → 400 for guest) is correct; guest without email → HTTPException 400. Idempotency uses (user_id or 'guest', key) as compound lookup; concurrent bursts (5 parallel) all return the SAME code and stock decrements exactly once — verified by direct Mongo read. Payment guard `payment.group=='cod'` → 400 keeps route closed even if a stale cod payment method exists in DB.

services/order_expiry.expire_pending_orders: correctly filters `status:pending, payment_deadline<now, NOT (payment_proofs.status=='pending')` before cancelling; cancel_reason='expired' persists; stock restore is atomic $inc; voucher redemption row is deleted and vouchers.used_count decremented via _release_voucher — verified end-to-end (delta=2 for 2 expired items).

routers/cron.expire_orders: Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET auth + X-Webhook-Id run-once dedupe via webhook_runs collection returns {duplicate:true} on second call — confirmed with same rid. Returns 202 (Accepted) fits async processing pattern; also asyncio.create_task offloads the sweep.

services/orders.transition_order: _release_voucher(order) fires when transitioning pending→cancelled regardless of cancel_reason (user vs expired vs admin). Idempotent because redemption doc is deleted by (order_code, voucher_code) match.

services/pricing.effective_shipping: applies free-shipping threshold BEFORE tax/fee calculation; when subtotal>=threshold sets shipping.price=0 and preserves method name; total math matches subtotal-discount+0.

frontend AddressDialog.js: email input has HTML type=email + client validate on save; save button disabled/error path keeps dialog open on empty/invalid email. Card shows checkout-address-email only when email is present. For logged-in customer the email is pre-seeded from user.email.

frontend OrderSuccessPage.js: hero data-state derived from (order.status, order.payment_status, order.cancel_reason). Total label switches between 'Total Tagihan' (unpaid) and 'Total Dibayar' (paid) — visible in screenshots. PaymentDeadline component powers order-payment-deadline + order-payment-countdown with a live setInterval-based countdown.

frontend AdminMediaPage.js refactor split into MediaPageView + MediaPageHelpers — page still exposes the same admin-media-* testids; folder rail, upload, 'Dari URL' (source download may 404 in sandbox — expected, not a bug), folder-baru dialog, and hotlink localize warning all render.

Minor: AdminSettingsPage.js still keeps SelectItem value='cod' in the payment-method Grup dropdown even though COD is no longer supported anywhere else (checkout, backend, storefront). Safe (backend rejects orders w/ group=cod) but should be removed to avoid dead operator UX.
test_credentials: admin@collectorparfum.id / Admin#2026, customer@collectorparfum.id / Customer#2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — both valid)
seed_data_creation: Created test orders CP00000143 (waiting, later cancelled), CP00000144 (paid via admin verify_proof), CP00000145 (customer-cancel, cancel_reason patched to 'expired' for UI state verification). test_fase1_sales.py also created & cancelled ~10 transient orders during idempotency/voucher/cron tests. Cleanup: CP00000143 cancelled at end of run; free_shipping_threshold verified back to 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 1 (SALES-06/07/09/10/13 + COD removal) is fully green. Run `python scripts/test_fase1_sales.py` for backend regression; run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sales_flow.py -o addopts=` for prior BUG-SALES-01..05. Frontend testids to reuse: checkout-payment-tab-transfer/-ewallet, address-input-email, address-save-button, checkout-address-email, checkout-free-shipping-note, order-success-hero[data-state], order-success-title, order-payment-deadline, order-payment-countdown, order-status-label, account-tab-orders, order-payment-deadline-compact, admin-order-status-select (must be count=0 on unpaid pending transfer), admin-media-*. Only cosmetic follow-up: drop SelectItem value='cod' in AdminSettingsPage.js Grup dropdown. Midtrans not implemented yet — do not test payment gateway flows.
rca of the issue: No functional issue. One cosmetic gap: admin payment-method Grup dropdown still allows COD selection despite COD being removed system-wide. Reproduction: /admin/pengaturan → Payment Methods → Tambah/Edit → Grup select → 'COD' option present. Mitigation: remove <SelectItem value='cod'>COD</SelectItem> at AdminSettingsPage.js:246.
